title: OES32 Membrane Array: atomic scale-out composition of fixed 32-slot OES32 membrane cells
description:
OES32 Membrane Array is a small Python companion to oes32-membrane-shield. It composes the fixed 32-slot OES32 membrane contract into arrays of 32 to 65,536 channel slots, always as a whole number of independent 32-slot cells, without changing the upstream API.

One external Ed25519 capability authorizes the whole flattened frame and binds the channel count. Every cell is validated before any state changes, so an update is accepted or rejected as one transaction; a residual breach latches an array-wide breaker that needs a guardian reset. Calibration requires independent CALIBRATEUR and GARDIEN approvals, and symmetry rules apply within each cell.

Scope: a software state-machine prototype on generated numbers. It is not a physical membrane, sensor array, hardware implementation, field result, medical device or performance benchmark; slot counts are configuration counts only, and no latency, throughput or independent security review is claimed.

Python 3.10+, depends on oes32-membrane-shield v2.0.1 and cryptography. 9 unittest tests and the scale demonstration run in GitHub Actions. License: AGPL-3.0-only.
